mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.1%, signaling potential recession, it triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 5.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices signals a robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and INDPRO both show upward trends over the past 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and INDPRO are rising simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary easing cycle, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate lowers discount rates, enhancing equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during periods when FEDFUNDS decline within the monetary easing cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in labor demand (PAYEMS) and overall demand (GDPC1) indices signals robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS and GDPC1 both above their 3-month moving averages
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both PAYEMS and GDPC1 are rising simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: An over-supplied goods market (INDPRO exceeding 120) indicates weakening demand, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when INDPRO exceeds 120.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% in a low unemployment regime signals robust labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when UNRATE falls below 4.5% within the low unemployment regime.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) and high demand (GDPC1) signals aggressive monetary expansion and robust economic activity, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns within the first 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS < 2.5% and GDPC1 > 11000.
